name: Di Fu
bio: Dr Di Fu is an Assistant Professor in Surrey's School of Psychology and an Interdisciplinary Principal Fellow at PAI. She directs SEIL Lab, linking social-cognitive experiments with computational modelling, human-robot interaction and human-AI research.
background: She received her PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience from the Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, in 2020, and undertook a joint PhD programme at the University of Hamburg from 2017 to 2020. Before joining Surrey, she was a Postdoctoral Research Associate in Hamburg's Department of Informatics, working on the Crossmodal Learning project from 2020 to 2023.

zh.role: 助理教授兼实验室主任
zh.paiRole: PAI 跨学科首席研究员
zh.bio: Di Fu 博士任职于萨里大学心理学院，并担任以人为本人工智能研究院 (PAI) 的跨学科首席研究员。她领导 SEIL Lab，将社会认知实验与计算建模、人机交互及人与 AI 交互研究相结合。
zh.background: 她于2020年获得中国科学院心理研究所认知神经科学博士学位，并于2017年至2020年参加汉堡大学联合博士项目。加入萨里大学前，她于2020年至2023年在汉堡大学信息学系担任博士后研究助理，参与 Crossmodal Learning 项目。
